items.description: An internal security platform that checks company assets for open ports, SSL certificates and HTTP header issues, then produces PDF reports.
items.summary: An internal security assessment platform for checking company assets and publishing the results as PDF reports.
overview: Pentest AMI is a web application for running security checks against Artha Mitra Interdata's own assets. Authorised staff register targets, run scans, review the findings and publish a report from one place.

Because the app sends active traffic to real hosts, every target has to pass an allowed-scope check twice: once when it is registered and again right before a scan starts, including a check on where its DNS name resolves.

features.title: Asset management
features.text: Keep a list of the assets that are authorised for testing.

features.title: Background scans
features.text: Scans run in workers, so long checks never block the app.

features.title: Core checks
features.text: Open ports, SSL certificates and HTTP security headers.

features.title: Findings review
features.text: Collect results per assessment and review them in one place.

features.title: PDF reports
features.text: Publish each assessment as a report that can be shared.

features.title: Controlled access
features.text: Role-based accounts with no self-registration.

notes: Every service runs in Docker Compose, with separate production settings.
Redis carries the job queue between the API and the workers.
A scheduler service starts planned scans.
Database changes are managed with Alembic migrations.

items.description: A company website for an IT solutions provider, covering products, solutions, news and activities, with an admin area for managing the content.
items.summary: A company website for an IT solutions provider, with a private admin area for managing its content.
overview: This is a website for Artha Mitra Interdata, an IT solutions integrator focused on infrastructure and security. It presents the company, its products and solutions, its news and its activities.
Page content is stored as structured files and edited through a private admin area, so the site can be updated without touching the code.

features.title: Company pages
features.text: About, products, solutions, insights, activities and contact.

features.title: Content admin
features.text: Edit page content and manage brands and solutions.

features.title: Two-step sign-in
features.text: Admin access needs a password and an authenticator code.

features.title: Restricted admin host
features.text: Admin routes only answer on an approved host.

features.title: Content backups
features.text: Keep backups of the content from the admin area.

features.title: Media uploads
features.text: Upload images for use across the site.

notes: Packaged with a multi-stage Docker build on Node 20 Alpine.
Docker Compose runs the web app next to a Redis service.
Also has a PM2 configuration for running on a server directly.
Includes scripts for security audits and dependency updates.

items.description: An internal system that brings employee data, attendance, leave, reimbursement and health claims together, with tiered approvals and email notifications.
items.summary: An internal system that brings employee data and office administration together, with tiered approvals and email notifications.
overview: Office Automation is an internal web application for managing employee data and day-to-day administration in one central system, covering both finance and technical processes.
Requests move through tiered approval flows, and every change is written to an audit log. Business rules live in a separate service layer so they can be tested without the interface.

features.title: Employee records
features.text: Employee history, documents, family data and certificates.

features.title: Attendance
features.text: Clock in and out, with history and recaps.

features.title: Leave
features.text: Requests, balances and a holiday calendar.

features.title: Reimbursement and health
features.text: Claims with limits and tracked payouts.

features.title: Tiered approvals
features.text: Configurable flows with several approval levels.

features.title: Notifications
features.text: Email alerts and scheduled reminders.

notes: Runs in Docker Compose with separate app, worker, database and proxy services.
A worker sends email and runs scheduled jobs from a queue stored in PostgreSQL, so Redis is not needed.
A migration step updates the database before the app starts.
A backup service keeps scheduled backups of the data.

items.description: A Covid-19 screening tool: upload a chest image in the Next.js app and a Flask service runs the model and returns the result.
items.summary: A Covid-19 screening tool with two paths: a chest image check and a symptom questionnaire.
overview: CovidX is an AI course project that explores early Covid-19 screening. A person can upload a chest image for detection, or answer a short questionnaire about their symptoms and exposure for a risk prediction.
It was built as a student project to learn how models fit into a real web app. It is not a medical tool.

features.title: Image detection
features.text: Upload a chest image and a trained model classifies it.

features.title: Symptom prediction
features.text: Answer yes or no questions to get a predicted result.

features.title: Web interface
features.text: A Next.js app with separate pages for each path.

features.title: Model API
features.text: A Flask service with one endpoint for each model.

notes: The frontend is deployed on Vercel.
The Flask service and the trained models run separately from the frontend.
The image model and the questionnaire model each have their own endpoint.

items.description: A Telegram bot built in n8n that turns a text prompt into an image or a video, then sends the result back in the chat.
items.summary: A Telegram bot that turns a text prompt into an image or a video, built as an n8n workflow.
overview: AI Automation is a Telegram bot that creates media on request. Someone picks image or video, sends a prompt, and receives the finished file in the same chat.
The whole flow is an n8n workflow. Generation takes time, so the workflow waits and keeps checking until the result is ready before it sends anything back.

features.title: Image or video
features.text: The bot asks which one to make before it takes a prompt.

features.title: Saved choices
features.text: The chosen mode and the prompt are kept in Google Sheets.

features.title: Generation jobs
features.text: Each request starts a job on a separate generator service.

features.title: Status checks
features.text: The workflow waits and checks again until the file is ready.

features.title: Delivery in chat
features.text: Finished images and videos are sent back through Telegram.

notes: A switch sends each message to the right step of the conversation.
Images and videos follow separate paths, each with its own wait and status loop.
n8n reaches the generator service through the Docker host address.
Finished images go through an asset upload step before they are sent.

items.description: A running tracker with daily check-ins, weekly streaks, gear mileage and AI training advice, built as a web app you can install on a phone.
items.summary: A running tracker with streaks, gear mileage, an AI coach and friends, built as an installable web app.
overview: Pelari Kalcer is a running tracker for recreational runners. Each day starts with one question, run or rest, and that check-in feeds a weekly streak, a calendar and personal statistics.

It can be used as a guest, and signing in with an email code saves the data to an account and unlocks friends, a run feed and chat. An AI coach reads recent training and drafts the plan for next week.

features.title: Daily check-in
features.text: Mark each day as run or rest, with distance and pace.

features.title: Weekly streaks
features.text: A race bib card tracks the streak, runs, distance and pace.

features.title: Run conditions
features.text: Temperature, rain chance, air quality and the best hour to run.

features.title: AI coach
features.text: Reads eight weeks of training and plans the next week.

features.title: Gear mileage
features.text: Distance is added to the chosen pair of shoes automatically.

features.title: Race mode
features.text: Set a target race, from 5K to a full marathon.

features.title: Friends and feed
features.text: Connect with a code, then share runs, comments and chat.

features.title: Installable app
features.text: Add it to a phone home screen and open it like an app.

notes: Only known numbers and fixed run types reach the AI, so notes, routes and gear are never sent.
A database function limits how many AI requests each account can make.
Row Level Security limits posts, likes and comments to the owner and their friends.
A service worker caches pages for the installed app.
